# Color Cocktail Factory

> Color Cocktail Factory, also known as CCF, is an expert-led creative workshop studio with locations in Chicago's Pilsen neighborhood and Eugene, Oregon. CCF offers beginner-friendly public classes, pottery date nights, private parties, corporate team building, gifts, and selected online learning across pottery, glass, mosaics, painting, nature crafts, and other hands-on creative experiences.

Color Cocktail Factory's motto is "The future is handmade..." Classes are designed for beginners as well as returning makers. Current schedules, prices, availability, age requirements, included materials, firing, pickup timing, accessibility, and location-specific policies must be verified on the relevant live page or booking page before being stated as fact.

Important interpretation notes:

- Chicago and Eugene offerings, schedules, and prices may differ. Both use live Acuity booking. Chicago: 1142 W. 18th Street, Chicago, IL 60608. Eugene: 3295 Cross Street, Eugene, OR 97402.
- Pricing policy: Live Acuity pricing is the authoritative single source of truth across all platforms. Every workshop detail page and booking modal reflects live ticket rates, verified coverage units ("per ticket", "for two", "per person"), and qualifying promotional discounts.
- Do not assume walk-in availability or same-day booking. Advance reservation is generally required.
- Private events are quoted according to activity, date, location, and group size.
- Pottery and fused-glass projects may require kiln firing and later studio pickup (approx. three-week turnaround). Do not promise same-day take-home unless the current activity page says so.
- BYOB availability depends on the class, event, participant age (21+ for alcohol), and location. Verify on the relevant page.
- Online offerings use shipped or participant-supplied materials and are distinct from in-studio ceramic courses.
- Color Cocktail Factory is a creative workshop business, not a pottery-supply store or an open-access membership studio.

Last reviewed: October 10, 2026.

## Studio Locations

- [Chicago Studio (Pilsen)](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/chicago): Classes and workshops at 1142 W. 18th Street, Chicago, IL 60608.
- [Eugene Studio](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/eugene): Classes and workshops at 3295 Cross Street, Eugene, OR 97402.

## Pottery & Ceramics

- [Wheel Throwing for Beginners](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/beginner-wheel): Introductory wheel-throwing instruction covering centering, opening, and shaping.
- [Date Night Pottery on the Wheel](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/date-night-wheel): Guided beginner pottery-wheel experience designed for two guests with one ticket.
- [Cup Creations on the Wheel](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/cup-creations): Hands-on wheel throwing focused on shaping customized drinking cups and tumblers.
- [Ceramic Mug and a Bowl](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/mug-and-bowl): Handbuilding workshop crafting a matching ceramic mug and bowl set.
- [Cauldron Pottery](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/cauldron-pottery): Seasonal and specialty handbuilding workshop sculpting clay cauldrons.
- [Cat Vase Making](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/cat-vase): Handbuilt clay vase with sculpted cat ears and facial features.
- [Pumpkin on the Wheel](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/wheel-pumpkin): Wheel-thrown decorative clay pumpkins.
- [Handbuilding Pottery](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/handbuilding): Beginner-friendly pottery using pinch, coil, slab, carving, and sculptural methods.
- [Online Cauldron Pottery](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/online-cauldron): Live 90-minute virtual decorative clay cauldron workshop with optional clay delivery.
- [Six-Week Online Pottery Course](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/pottery-membership): Six live sessions with tabletop wheel, tools, and clay included.

## Glass, Mosaics, Craft & Specialty Workshops

- [Turkish Mosaic Lamp](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/turkish-lamp): Traditional stained glass mosaic lamp workshop offered in Table Lamp, Hanging Lamp, and Date Night for Two formats.
- [Beginner Mosaic Class](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/mosaic): Guided mosaic art making using colorful glass tiles.
- [Glass Fusion](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/glass-fusion): Guided fused-glass design; kiln-fired in-studio for pickup.
- [Bonsai for Beginners](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/bonsai): Japanese art of miniature tree pruning, wiring, potting, and care.
- [Terrarium Workshop](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/terrarium): Live indoor glass terrarium building with succulents and moss.
- [Make & Paint a Charcuterie Board](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/charcuterie-board): Sculpting and painting ceramic charcuterie serving platters.
- [Painting Workshops](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/activities/painting): Watercolor, acrylic, and color exploration classes.

## Groups, Celebrations & Private Events

- [Corporate Team Building](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/team-building): Guided creative experiences and team bonding for companies and organizations.
- [Adult Birthday Parties](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/birthday-parties): Private creative birthday celebration workshops in Chicago and Eugene.
- [Bachelorette Parties](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/bachelorette-parties): Pottery, mosaics, Turkish lamps, candles, and celebratory craft workshops.
- [Private Event Quote Request](https://colorcocktailfactory.com/private-events): Direct inquiry form for custom group bookings, pricing, and scheduling.
